**INCIDENT FORENSICS REPORT**
**Date: 2024-11-26**
**Evidence: mta-2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap**

**INFECTED HOST**
- IPv4 Address: 10.11.26.183
- MAC Address: d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b
- Windows Hostname: DESKTOP-B8TQK49
- Windows Domain: nemotodes.health (Workgroup: NEMOTODES)
- Logged-in User Account: Oliver Q. Boomwald (LDAP DN: CN=Oliver Q.. Boomwald,CN=Users,DC=nemotodes,DC=health)

**MALWARE FAMILY**
- NetSupport RAT (Remote Administration Tool)
- Attribution: Signature-confirmed via ETPRO Suricata alerts and behavioral analysis of C2 protocol structure (CMD=POLL, INFO, ACK, ENCD parameters)

**COMMAND-AND-CONTROL INFRASTRUCTURE**

*Primary C2 Server:*
- 194.180.191.64:443 (HTTP over port 443)
- C2 Checkin URL: http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm
- Beacon Interval: 60 seconds (regular POST requests observed from 08:51:46 through end of capture)
- Protocol: Application-layer C2 commands sent as HTTP POST with encrypted data (ENCD parameter)

*Secondary C2 Infrastructure:*
- 104.26.1.231:80 (geo.netsupportsoftware.com - NetSupport geolocation lookup)

**MALICIOUS DOMAINS**
- modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP malware distribution domain; identified in DNS queries and TLS SNI; signature-confirmed as ET CURRENT_EVENTS ZPHP Domain)

**INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE**

*C2 Communications:*
- 73 HTTPS connections from victim to 194.180.191.64:443
- Continuous beaconing pattern with 60-second intervals
- POST requests to /fakeurl.htm with application/x-www-form-urlencoded payloads
- C2 response file SHA-256: 2b69346572041eefe558a82b58d654237e087ce9ab4e0876254a40a8954279a9

*Lateral Movement:*
- SMB/NetBIOS scanning and exploitation attempts against 10.11.26.3 (domain controller) on ports 139 and 445
- SAMR (SAM Remote) queries: OpenUser, QueryUserInfo, GetGroupsForUser
- LDAP GSS-API authenticated searches against domain controller for user "Oliver Q. Boomwald"
- EfsRpc (Encrypting File System Remote Protocol) channel opened to domain controller

*Malware Distribution:*
- Multiple DNS queries to modandcrackedapk.com (times: 08:50:14, 08:50:15, 08:50:40)
- TLS connection to modandcrackedapk.com with SNI (IP resolver shows resolution attempt)

**ATTACK TIMELINE**
- 08:49:38 - Initial system activity (Windows connectivity checks, LDAP queries)
- 08:50:10 - NetBIOS/SMB scanning of domain controller begins
- 08:50:14 - First DNS query to malicious domain modandcrackedapk.com
- 08:50:40 - TLS connection to modandcrackedapk.com (likely payload staging)
- 08:50:45 - NetSupport RAT C2 beaconing begins to 194.180.191.64:443
- 08:50:45 - Geolocation lookup to 104.26.1.231
- 08:51:46 onwards - Regular 60-second C2 beacons established

**ASSESSMENT**
Host 10.11.26.183 is compromised with NetSupport RAT malware. The malware established persistent C2 communication to 194.180.191.64 with regular beaconing behavior. Lateral movement activities targeting the domain controller indicate potential post-exploitation enumeration and privilege escalation attempts. The attack chain involves infection via modandcrackedapk.com (likely cracked/modded APK distribution site repurposed for malware delivery).
